description: Interactions implied by each model for the pre-specified RQ2 pairs (fatal, test crashes)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity (fatal: MAXSEV_IM 9 excluded; ka: MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded, so ka rows are a subset); train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Four-scenario standardisation over 3,000 weight-proportional test crashes; fatal metrics use every crash with a known fatal outcome; ka metrics use only the crashes where ka is known (MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded), so the two outcomes differ in n
